summary: Opt-in GPU stall watchdog; RoCEnante health checked on every rank
compatibility: No user action required: the watchdog is off unless VLLM_GPU_STALL_DUMP_SECONDS is set. Its cuda-gdb section needs ptrace permission (SYS_PTRACE or --privileged in a container); without it the dump keeps the Python stacks and RoCEnante state.
details: With VLLM_GPU_STALL_DUMP_SECONDS set, every rank writes one dump under $VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/gpu_stall/ when a step's GPU work, or the step call itself on the host, stays unfinished that long, or when a RoCEnante wait on that rank times out: the RoCEnante protocol snapshot, every Python thread's stack, and the running kernels with the SASS at their PC via cuda-gdb.

The RoCEnante fail-stop check now covers every live communicator on every rank, so a peer's timeout names the missing rank in that rank's log instead of going unread when the output rank's own GPU stopped.
